You've received a new message from Futaba Fukuyama!
scene sky
The second day of the beach trip begins with the customary gathering of a bunch of young girls in bathing suits around a breakfast table.
And while Touka’s family graciously catered this for us, Touka herself could not be any more distraught if she tried.
This is evidenced by the fact that she has already begun to make phone calls for a helicopter or something as her surrogate daughter has still not returned from the woods.
And, distressingly, neither has mine.
A few girls are feeling the effects of this, but a good portion of them seem to believe they’ll find their way back soon enough.
And a few more of them aren’t even here as they’re part of a small batch who moved further down the beach for their own competitions.
I wonder to myself if they even know their friends are still missing- or if they’ll wind up getting lost too and I’ll be left with a significantly smaller roster of teenagers to corrupt.
But these thoughts are cut short.
Not just by my subconscious desire to change-
But by the unmissable rising of several heads and the clamor that accompanies them.
scene yasumadeitback1
$ beachwarfloor2points += 1
: I smell something sweet...
: Yo, Touka! Your girl’s back! Hang up the-
: Yasu! Thank heavens you’re- wait, why in the world are you still wearing your blindfold?! I told you to take it off after I left!
scene yasumadeitback2
: Touka!
: Don’t “Touka” me! You had me worried sick!
: You worried about a worthless ant like me? You’re so nice!
scene yasumadeitback3
: “Worried” barely even begins to describe the anguish I felt! What if something happened to you? What if you were abducted or...broke your leg or...other bad things like that?! Then what?!
: Am I in trouble? Did I lose the game?
: No, Yasu. You won the stupid game. But you could have gotten hurt and-
scene yasumadeitback4
: And this is all of your fault!
: Who are you yelling at? Makoto and Uta aren’t even here and they’re the ones who came up with the contests.
: Everyone! The fact that no one attempted to put a stop to this dangerous contest is a travesty and shall not be forgotten! Mark my words!
: Touka, yelling is bad. You’re going to damage your vocal cords and your pretty voice will start to sound more like the sand.
scene yasumadeitback5
: I have more important things to care about than my pretty voice! You should all be ashamed!
scene yasumadeitback6
: Come on, Yasu! We’re going back to the room and having breakfast without any of these girls so they can better understand just how mad I am!
: Okay, but can I have my blindfold back? It helps me see better.
: Absolutely not! Never again!
: Never?!
: What’s wrong Maya? You seem a little out of it.
: I’m alert as ever. I’m just confused about how Yasu managed to make it back to the beach with a blindfold still on faster than Ayane has without one.
: To be fair, we won’t really know if Ayane took the blindfold off until she gets back. I didn’t see her do it, so there’s really no way of knowing if she listened to my instructions or not.
scene yasumadeitback7
: Well, now that she’s already lost...we should be able to go out looking for her, right?
: Have a little more faith in her, Maya! Ayane’s easily the smartest member of the Sensei Love Squad. I’m sure she’ll figure it out sooner rather than later.
: First, stop putting me in your stupid squad. Second, sooner already happened. She’s been out there for like twelve hours, hasn’t she? I think this qualifies as later, Ami.
: And I think you should give Ayane a little more credit. I believe in her and you should too!
: Why...are you being so positive about this?
scene yasumadeitback8
: Good question. I was really worried all night, so it’s kinda weird that I’m just okay with it now.
: Maybe I’ve hit the “acceptance” phase?
: The...what?
scene yasumadeitback9
: Hey, are you gonna eat your omelet? It looks really good.
scene black
: I’m...not really hungry right now...
scene yasumadeitback10
: The fuck’s got you all quiet back there? Shouldn’t you be talkin’ about how much you love little girls right now or somethin’?
: I had a long night. I’m tired.
: You are lucky we came to a temporary truce and allowed you to sleep. I was prepared to go all night long.
: Yeah, well...you definitely weren’t the only one.
: You worried about Blondie still bein’ out there and shit? She’s like, your number one fan after your creepazoid niece, ain’t she?
: Yes. This may come as a surprise to you, Yumi, but I do actually care about people sometimes. And I would like her to come back now.
scene yasumadeitback11
: Well, I definitely ain’t a fan of her. But I hope she didn’t get hurt or some shit.
: I got lost in those woods once when I was little and, let me tell you, that ain’t an easy place to escape from once you get turned around.
: What were you doing wandering through the woods as a child?
: Fuck if I remember. Shit was like six million years ago at this point.
: So, are you two planning on doing this all day again? Because I want to keep sulking, but I feel pressured not to while both of you are watching me.
scene yasumadeitback12
: That is the plan, yes. I have already been porked by the Tsukioka Foundation this morning and am prepared to go all day as well.
: If we’re lucky, it won’t last long. Think Ponytail is gettin’ fed up with this BS as well. Bitch has barely even made a pass at you and her opponent ain’t even here.
: That’s kind of just how Maya is. I doubt she’ll try to win at all.
: If I’ve gotta rip her arms off and make her hug you myself, I’ll do it.
: That would not count as a hug. The arms need to be attached to a body. A hug with arms alone is just a meat costume.
scene yasumadeitback13
: God, I hope this shit ends soon.
scene yasumadeitback14
: Hey. Everybody else I normally talk to is either busy or not here right now, so let’s pretend we like each other for a little while so it doesn’t look like we’re loners.
: Well, that was awfully blunt.
: Yeah, I’m good at that.
: You know I don’t, like...actually have anything against you, right? That stuff when you were trying to join the club was all just jealousy.
: Obviously I know that. And that’s fine. But it doesn’t mean I don’t have anything against you.
: Okay. Well, since you’ve decided to sit next to and tell me this, why not just air your issues out with me now?
scene yasumadeitback15
: Sure. I don’t like how you treat Rin.
scene yasumadeitback16
: What’s wrong with the way I treat Rin?
: The part where you try to control who she looks at and who she talks to. And how you’ll ghost her for days at a time while she cries and worries about whether or not she did something wrong.
: The part where you don’t trust her. And the part where every time I’ve heard you say something nice to her, it’s always weirdly forced and disingenuous.
scene yasumadeitback17
: I also don’t like the way you look at her. Or how she feels pressured to hide the things she likes because she doesn’t want to look nerdy in front of you. Or how you took the red out of your bangs.

: Basically, I don’t like how you two are approaching your relationship from different angles. And yes, you’re just teenagers. But Rin is my friend and I think she deserves someone better. That is all.
: Well, damn. That was a lot.
: Also, if you tell her I said any of that, I will gut you.
scene yasumadeitback18
: Chika, can I level with you for a second?
: Uhh...sure?
: I think you’re right about, like...90%% of that. Rin does deserve someone better than me. And she’s been way more serious about this than I have from the get-go.
: What is happening right now?
: What is happening is I’m being called out for the shitty things I do and the shitty things I will probably continue to do because I am a shitty person.
scene yasumadeitback19
: I’m new as fuck to all of this. I started dating Rin because I thought she was chill and it kind of just...blew up into this big, huge thing I wasn’t at all prepared for.
: And, like...yeah. I’ve got some feelings for her. But they’re not the same as the ones she has for me. And I have no clue if they ever will be.
: Then break up with her.
scene yasumadeitback20
: Chika, I don’t care how blunt or “defensive” you are, but it’s not your place to go up to your friend’s girlfriend and tell her to end the relationship. That’s just fucked.
: Like, what do you think Rin would say if she heard any of this?
: What do you think Rin would say if she heard you flat out admit to not caring about her?
: She’d probably cry. And then we’d get into a fight or something. And then we’d make up. Because, like you said, we’re teenagers. We’ve got no fucking clue what we’re doing.

: And, just to clarify, I do care about her. And I know she’d have been way better off with someone like you. But you rejected her. You fucked her up way worse than I ever have. Well, at least...so far.
scene yasumadeitback21
: That was way different, Otoha. I already had someone. If Rin had come to me a year earlier, I would have probably said yes.
: But she didn’t. And you didn’t. So you can dislike me all you want, but you don’t really have a say in her love life. She can date whoever she wants. And right now, that person is me.
: But why do you want to date her? What are you getting out of this?
scene yasumadeitback22
: Right now? Nothing but enemies, confusion, and a shit ton of nudes.
: You fucking-
: But who’s to say that’s all it’ll ever be? Maybe I actually will fall in love with her further down the line or something?
: Or maybe someone else will catch your eye and you’ll move on to a new experiment instead?
scene yasumadeitback23
: Maybe, yeah. But isn’t it the same for you?
: What? What are you talking about?
: Are you really going to stay interested in whoever you’re seeing now for the rest of your life? You’re a freshman.
: I’m supposed to be a sophomore. And yes, I do expect to stay interested in that person forever. That’s what a successful relationship is like.
: Mhm. But what if that person fucked you over or cheated on you or something?
: He wouldn’t do that.
: But if he did?
: He wouldn’t.
: But...if he did?
scene yasumadeitback24
: Oh man. I like you even less now.
: Well, don’t hate me too much or your plan of “making it look like we like each other” won't work very well.
: You don’t deserve her, Otoha.
: Thanks. I’ll keep that in mind the next time I’m fingering her.
: Fuck you.
: Fuck me indeed, Chika.
scene black
: Fuck me indeed.
scene yasumadeitback25
: Io, explain to me the rules of this contest thingy again please? The heck even is this thing?
: It’s called “wood.” You use it to build stuff. Which is also the purpose of this competition.
scene yasumadeitback26
: How the heck am I supposed to build stuff with just this?! I don’t have any tools!
: Ain’t my fault you didn’t come prepared. Rules said we had to bring our own.
: Well...can I borrow some of yours then?
: Sure, once I’m done measuring everything out. I’ll even show you how to use a saw.
scene yasumadeitback27
: Oh! A saw is-
: I know what a friggin’ saw is! I just don’t know the first thing about puttin’ a raft together!
: What happened to that fighting spirit from yesterday? Weren’t you all like, “Gaaah. It’s not over ‘til it’s over!” and stuff?
scene yasumadeitback28
: Yeah, but now it’s over and I can complain as much as I want.
: I told you this wasn’t easy. But again, I’m happy to show you the ropes once I have my raft planned out.
: Easiest course of action would be to go with a standard design, but I might try and spice things up a bit if I have the time. Maybe add like a...sail or something.
: I think it would still count as a raft if there’s a sail, right? Not sure how strict we plan on getting with nautical-craft terminology here.
: I, Miku Maruyama...for the first time ever...have grossly underestimated my opponent...
: Well, if you’re not gonna do anything, why not come over here and help me with mine. I could use another-
scene yasumadeitback29
: Aye-aye, Captain Io! First-mate Miku reporting for service!
: Maybe wait until we have the prototype built to start calling me Captain.
scene yasumadeitback30
: Prototype? You’re buildin’ two of these things? You just flexin’ on me now, Captain?
: Not at all. The prototype will be super small — like, only big enough for one person. The finished product should be able to fit all four of us who came out here.
: I just want to make sure what I’m making does its job and actually floats since I’ve never used this kind of wood before.
: Are all kinds of wood not the same?
scene yasumadeitback31
: Miku, come on. That’s like asking if all wrenches are the same.
: Are...all wrenches not the same?
scene yasumadeitback32
: You know what? Maybe we should just talk about something else instead? Teaching you everything from the beginning might take a little longer than I initially thought...
: Works for me! As somebody who’s only just now gettin’ in touch with her feminine side, I’ve been fiendin’ for a little girl talk!
scene yasumadeitback33
: Ew, no. I’m the last person you want to do that with.
: Are you? Just cause you’re into buildin’ and stuff doesn’t mean ya can’t be a little girly too, ya know.
scene yasumadeitback34

: Yeah. It’s the “being girly” thing in general I have a problem with. Like, what even is “girl talk?” Are we supposed to gossip about like...celebrities or...TikTok or something? Pass. Hand me a hammer.
: You know what a hammer is, right?
: I know what a hammer is. And I was kinda just figurin’ we’d talk about who we like or somethin’.
scene yasumadeitback35
: Do you have feelings for someone, Miku?
: As a matter of fact, I do.
: Just to be sure- we are talking about a male, right?
: As a matter of fact, we are.
: You see...I, the amazing Miku Maruyama...have fallen for our very own teacher. Sensei...Senseison.
scene yasumadeitback36
: You have?
: I have.
: Wow. So is, like...everybody in our class into older guys? Because it’s starting to feel that way and it’s very weird.
scene yasumadeitback37
: Wait, do you like Sensei too?
: I’d say “like” is a bit of an understatement. I’m kind of obsessed with him in a really unhealthy way and it’s definitely going to make him hate me one day.
scene yasumadeitback38
: That’s awesome!
: It...It is?
: Well, not the hatin’ you part. But that part that you’re able to like somebody so much!
: I’m confused. I thought this was the part where you start to hate me for liking the same guy as you. Isn’t that how...girl-code works or whatever?
: I don’t know anything about this “girl code” stuff. But I ain’t got any problems when it comes to somebody likin’ the same guy as me.
: Makoto says I’m weird for it, but I’m kinda just excited to share my happiness with people I care about, you know? And if they can be happy too, it’s even better!
: I said something similar to Uta and she thought I was weird for it as well, so...I think I know where you’re coming from.
: Does that, like...expand to...physical stuff too, though?

: Like, in the hypothetical but realistic scenario where Sensei chooses you over me, and I am hypothetically and less realistically interested in sex in said scenario...would it bother you sharing him that way?
: Or do you, like...not even consider that when-
: I love all that sex stuff! It wouldn’t bother me one bit!
: This is not at all the dialogue I envisioned having when I set out to build a raft this morning.
: Are you interested in that stuff too, Io?
scene yasumadeitback39
: Not even a little. Where is my hammer?
: Why do you need a hammer for a screw?
: I need a hammer to bash my brain in before I start spiraling.
: Forget your pills back at the inn? Want me to run and get ‘em? I’m really fast. You should time me.
: One...Two...Three.
scene yasumadeitback40
: Gah! I wasn’t ready yet! Start over!
: I’ll be back soon!
: Hah...
scene black
scene yasumadeitback41
: Makoto, this is boring as shit.
: Tell me you don’t understand the beauty of fishing without telling me you don’t understand the beauty of fishing.
: I will gladly tell you I don’t “understand the beauty of fishing” because, again, this is boring as shit.
: Let’s go start another round of the swimsuit competition. You missed the first half yesterday and I want one of our teachers to think about fucking me.
scene yasumadeitback42
: You might actually enjoy this if you gave it a shot, you know.
: What does it look like I’m doing? You think I’d be wasting away my morning on a dock if I wasn’t open to “giving this a shot?”
: What I think is that complaining about something while you’re doing it ruins any chance you could have at enjoying yourself.
scene yasumadeitback43
: Just close your eyes...listen to the wind and the birds...and wait for a tug on the line...
scene yasumadeitback44
: Empty your mind...Free yourself from the worries that swarm you in your day to day life...and become one with the world itself...
: There should be nothing there...nothing at all...just peace...and quiet...and relaxation...
: Now, picture something that would bring you true happiness...
: What do you see?
: Sensei and Imani with a strap-on double-teaming me.
scene yasumadeitback45
: Why am I not surprised?
: What’s actually surprising is how into this you are. Is this, like...a hobby of yours or something?
: It’s just weird to pick a contest so laid-back when everything else in the Dorm Wars is normally pretty active. But if you’re into it, then...
scene yasumadeitback46
: I wouldn’t say it’s a hobby. It’s been years since I’ve done this, actually. But my dad loved it and I would tag along with him when I was younger.
: So in a sense, this is kind of therapeutic for me. Like a way to connect with him without actually being able to anymore.
: Sorry if that made you uncomfortable.
scene yasumadeitback47
: It didn’t. I’m good.
: Good.
: I’m sorry that happened to you, Makoto. I don’t think I ever got to say that.
: You didn’t need to. That sort of thing is just implied whenever you come back to school following a death in the family.
: I know, but I still feel like I should either way. And it’s really cool you were able to recover from that.
scene yasumadeitback48
: Does this sudden niceness have something to do with Miku? Because if she’s been asking you to take pity on me or something, I’m fine. You don’t need to-
: Miku doesn’t have anything to do with it. But I guess I can understand why you’d think she does.
: It’s weird that we have the same best friend but that every time we’ve tried to talk to each other it’s been all...confrontational for the most part.
scene yasumadeitback49
: That’s on me too. I’ve been silently kicking myself for being such a bitch to you on Christmas last year when I wouldn’t let you hang out in the bedroom with us.
: Yeah, that hurt. But it’s not like I’ve been a saint either.
: I don’t really, like...believe in karma or anything like that. But I do think that life often takes on the colors you wind up spitting out yourself.
: It makes sense that nobody would like me when I don’t really give anyone a reason to.
: If you somehow haven’t noticed yet, I’m not exactly the most popular girl in class either.
: Yeah, but that’s because you’re too good and it pisses everybody off. All I’ve done is carve out a little niche and stick to, like...two people I’m comfortable with.
: Everyone else either hates me or thinks I’m a slut.
scene yasumadeitback50
: For what it’s worth, Kirin...I don’t hate you.
: Then you probably think I’m a slut. Right?
: I think you say things that make it sound that way. But I can’t imagine you actually sleeping around when it seems like you’d be happy just finding someone who understands you.
scene yasumadeitback51
: Also, as someone who grew up directly above a sex shop and now works in said sex-shop, I may have subconsciously ousted the word “slut” from my vocabulary.
: I think I’m supposed to call people like that “sex positive” instead or something. My mom would know better than I do.
: Something wrong? Or are you just finally starting to understand the allure of fishing in silence?
scene yasumadeitback52
: Nothing’s wrong. And I still think this is boring as shit.
: But...
: You can be kind of cool when...you’re not handing us worksheets.
: Th...Thank you, Kirin...I appreciate that.
: Don’t mention it.
: You know...you’ve seemed a little different than normal lately, now that I think about it.
: You’re probably just imagining it. I’m still the same person I’ve always been.
: If you say so, but...
: Change doesn’t have to be a bad thing, just so you know.
: In fact...for people like us, who struggle to socially thrive the way Miku does...I think change is mostly good.
scene sky
: Something I’ve learned recently is that having strong relationships to fall back on goes a long way in helping you through the worst days of your life.
: And I hope, for your sake, those days are still far away...
: But I wouldn’t blame you for doing whatever it is you need to do to find a few more lifelines as well.
: Thanks, Makoto. I’ll add that to my to-do list right after getting Sensei and Imani to double-team me.
: And to that I say — I admire your “sex positivity.”
: That’s just what your mom would want you to say.
: Well, it’s not as if I can ask my dad how he’d respond on account of the whole being dead thing.
: Okay, now I’m uncomfortable.
